notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least six.
description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Lore Weaver by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.
